# Switch polarity

```r
switchPolarity(obj, ..., track = TRUE)

## S4 method for signature 'GPR'
switchPolarity(obj, track = TRUE)

## S4 method for signature 'GPRsurvey'
switchPolarity(obj, sel, track = TRUE)
```

## Arguments

- `obj`: (`GPR`) An object of the class GPR.
- `track`: (`logical[1]`) Should the processing step be tracked?

## Returns

(`GPR`) An object of the class GPR whose traces are dewowed.

## Description

Switch polarity
